references.text: Direct narrative continuation showing the escalation of war and God's permission of temporary defeat before final victory.
Repeated battle order at Gibeah demonstrates Israel's enduring courage and God's structured disciplining of the people.
Repeated action after defeat highlights the theme of restoration and persistent faith in God's service.
Direct narrative connection where the formation in verse 30 enables the ambush and victory described in verse 36.
The consequence of the battle begun in verse 30, showing God's fulfillment of judgment through pursuit.
